questions.question: Which attribute must be added to <video> to display play, pause, and volume controls?
questions.explanation: The controls boolean attribute enables the browser's native audio/video playback control interface.

questions.question: Why will <video autoplay> typically fail to play automatically in modern browsers?
options: Modern browsers require the muted attribute alongside autoplay
Autoplay requires a paid enterprise license
questions.hint: Browsers require video to be muted for autoplay.
questions.explanation: To prevent disturbing users, modern web browsers only allow autoplay if the video is muted (<video autoplay muted>).

questions.question: Which attribute defines a placeholder preview thumbnail image displayed before a video plays?
questions.explanation: The poster attribute specifies an image URL to show while the video downloads or until the user hits play.

questions.question: What is the purpose of nesting multiple <source> elements inside <video>?
options: To play multiple videos simultaneously in picture-in-picture
To provide alternative video formats (WebM, MP4) for cross-browser compatibility
To load videos from different databases simultaneously
questions.explanation: Nesting multiple <source> elements allows the browser to select the first supported codec format.

questions.question: Which element adds accessible subtitles, captions, and translations to an HTML5 video?
questions.explanation: <track> specifies timed text tracks (subtitles or captions) using WebVTT format.
